brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into the book. In Chapters 8 and 9, the outlaws hide the boys in a hut in the forest. Find a spot where a hut could hide, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? That’s okay. It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about the hideout.
extra: Find a spot that would be a bad hideout. Say why the outlaws would not hide there.
step1: You won’t build today. You will find a good hiding spot. Read the four things to look for. This list is also in VR: open your menu, click the Canvas tab, then pick our assignment.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click the Explore tab. Type Forest in the Filter environments box and click Medieval Forest. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Walk and teleport through the forest. Find a spot with trees close together, far from the path, in deep shade, with room for a small hut.
step4: Stand in your spot and say this out loud. This is a good hideout because… and finish the sentence. The king’s soldiers would not find it because… and finish that one too.
step5: Stand back so you can see the trees around your hiding spot. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until it all fits, then click Take photo. Now click the Canvas tab and pick 19.2 VR · The Outlaws’ Hideout. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Last, press the Meta button and click Quit.
